component.name: Palmier Pro
component.summary: AI-native multi-track video editor with GPU acceleration

description.p: Palmier Pro for Linux is an AI-native, multi-track video editor with first-class GPU acceleration for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel graphics, and a graceful CPU fallback when no compatible GPU is available. It is the ground-up C++20 Linux port of Palmier Pro, built with Qt 6, FFmpeg, and Vulkan.

ul.li: Multi-track timeline editing (1-50 tracks) with trim, split, move, and reorder.
GPU-accelerated decoding, encoding, effects, and playback with zero-copy frames.
A local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for external AI agents over loopback HTTP.
An in-app agent chat that drives the editor through the same tool surface.
In-timeline generative AI (account-gated closed service), transcription, and key-moment detection.

description.p: The Timeline Editor and MCP Server are free software under the GNU GPL v3 (or later) and remain fully functional with no network connection to the generative service.
Initial Linux port: timeline editor, GPU acceleration, MCP server, and agent chat.
